prompt_additions.task_line_forward:
Task: FORWARD digit span.
The human must recall the digits in the SAME order they appeared (first digit first).
prompt_additions.task_line_reverse:
Task: REVERSE digit span.
The human must recall the digits in REVERSE order, last digit first. This is NOT the forward task -- the response is the presented sequence read backwards.
prompt_additions.reasoning_preamble:
First think about how this particular human would encode and recall the sequence, inside a single block:
<reasoning>
... your reasoning about what they would hold on to and what they would lose ...
</reasoning>
Keep the reasoning to at most three sentences. Do not work through the sequence step by step, and do not second-guess yourself -- state what this human would encode and what would slip, then stop.
